newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy May electricity consumption up 4 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Italy May electricity consumption up 4 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Italian electricity consumption rose a seasonally and calendar adjusted four percent year-on-year in May compared with May 1996, electricity company Enel said on Thursday.
Consumption rose 2.9 percent on an unadjusted basis. Enel said in a statement that 22.2 billion kWh of electricity was used in May.
In the first five months of 1997, consumption rose 1.9 percent on an adjusted basis and 0.6 percent on an unadjusted basis. Demand in May was boosted by industry and the tertiary sector, Enel said.
Enel said net national production was 18.7 billion kWh of electricity, some 3.2 percent higher than in May 1996.
